subject: Subscripts
notes: kb/Work PB201 (2026-09-04). CobolTable.At is the ONE occurrence-number to element mapping and it is edition-independent - no edition branch - so the 1..n bound holds identically at every edition; ec_bound_subscript pins the NAMED condition under >>TURN EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT CHECKING ON with a USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION declarative and RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT. With checking OFF the reference continues into a re-defaulted scratch slot, the implementor choice 13.18.38.4 GR7 leaves open by making out-of-bounds occurrence content undefined, and the only posture COBOL-85 can take since it has no exception conditions. PB201 added the piece that was missing on the way IN: every wide carrier (an Int128 >18-digit item, an unsigned BINARY-CAPACITY container, and an alphanumeric image FromAlphanumeric decodes to up to 38 digits) now narrows through CobolNum.Position, which SATURATES. A plain (long) cast wraps, and a wrapped position can land back inside 1..n - turning a condition this rule requires to be detected into a silent wrong answer.
